{"consolidated_memory":"PARTIAL UPLOAD ISSUES IN storage/blob/uploader.rs — TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

INCIDENT 1: [2026-02-11] Race Condition in Lazy Initialization
- Component: storage/blob/uploader.rs (storage side)
- Problem: Partial upload not completing
- Trigger: Input list came in empty
- Signal: A final part that never gets acknowledged
- Root Cause: Race condition in lazy initialization
- Fix: Guarded initialization with double-checked lock
- PR: #1628, branch fix/partial-upload-1
- Reproduction: Upload 40 MB fixture over throttled link
- Measured Outcome: p99 latency fell from 2.6 s to 439 ms

INCIDENT 2: [2026-02-27] Timezone-Aware DateTime Mismatch
- Component: storage/blob/uploader.rs (storage side)
- Problem: Partial upload not completing (same symptom as incident 1)
- Trigger: Occurred after client had already retried once
- Signal: A final part that never gets acknowledged
- Root Cause: Naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
- Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR: #2208, branch fix/partial-upload-2
- Reproduction: Upload 40 MB fixture over throttled link
- Measured Outcome: Flaky test failures reduced from 36 per hundred runs to zero
- Stack: Rust; test coverage via module test block in storage/blob/uploader.rs
- Note: This incident occurred 16 days after incident 1, indicating a separate manifestation of the same symptom with different underlying cause"}
